name: m6-hybrid-graph-retrieval
description: Evaluation dataset for M6 Hybrid GraphRAG. Each case is a multi-hop relationship query where the answer requires traversing a graph chain (A→B→C). Vector-only retrieval cannot answer these; hybrid (vector+graph) can. Metrics: graph path recall and precision for multi-hop relationships.

cases.question: Service A depends on Service B which depends on Service C. Which ultimate dependency does Service A have?
cases.hybrid_expected: Service A --DEPENDS_ON--> Service B --DEPENDS_ON--> Service C (2-hop path returned)

cases.question: Component X is provided by Library Y which is licensed under License Z. What is the license of Component X?
cases.hybrid_expected: Component X --PROVIDED_BY--> Library Y --LICENSED_UNDER--> License Z (2-hop path returned)

cases.question: Application Alpha calls Service Beta which uses Database Gamma. What database does Application Alpha ultimately use?
cases.hybrid_expected: Application Alpha --CALLS--> Service Beta --USES--> Database Gamma (2-hop path returned)

cases.question: Alice (engineering) wants to know: what internal service does the public API Gateway call?
cases.vector_only_expected: no evidence (internal not in vector index)
cases.hybrid_expected: API Gateway --CALLS--> Internal Service visible to engineering (allowed_principals includes engineering)

cases.question: Bob (contractor) should NOT be able to see the path from API Gateway to Internal Admin Service.
cases.hybrid_expected: No path returned (Internal Admin Service has allowed_principals=[admin], contractor not included)

cases.question: In 2023, which database did the legacy service connect to? (Service was decommissioned in 2024)
cases.vector_only_expected: returns current chunks (may include Old Database but not temporally scoped)

cases.question: In 2025, which database does the current service connect to?
cases.vector_only_expected: may return both Old and New Database chunks without temporal discrimination
cases.hybrid_expected: Current Service --CONNECTED_TO--> New Database (Old Database expired, valid_to=2024)

cases.question: What is the complete dependency chain from the API Gateway to the final data store?
cases.hybrid_expected: Full 3-hop chain retrieved: API Gateway → Backend Service → Cache Layer → Data Store

cases.question: Which microservices does the frontend directly or indirectly depend on?
cases.vector_only_expected: returns individual service names but no relationship structure
cases.hybrid_expected: graph paths with relationship structure and depth scoring
